stem: A dry-room RH excursion lasted from 01:20 to 04:50. Lots A and B were present for the full event; Lot C entered at 05:30 after verified recovery. Which scope statement is strongest?
choices: All three lots are automatically affected because they are now in the same room
Lots A and B require evaluation for the excursion; Lot C should not be included solely on current room location because it entered after recovery
Only Lot C is affected because it entered most recently
No lot is affected unless visible damage appears
rationale: Affected scope should follow time, location, and genealogy evidence. A lot entering after verified recovery is not exposed to the earlier excursion merely because it later occupies the room.
